## Gym visual media is excluded

Images and GIFs are © Gym visual — https://gymvisual.com/ and are NOT covered
by the dataset's MIT license. Forge50 includes no such media in this
integration and claims no permission to redistribute it. Upstream permission
does not transfer to Forge50. Cloning either repository grants no media rights.

The isolated demonstration adapter is disabled by default. Obtain separate
permission for Forge50 before supplying or enabling any Gym visual assets.
The adapter retains attribution and supports the upstream 180×180 format;
these technical measures do not grant a license.

Gym visual terms: https://gymvisual.com/content/3-terms-and-conditions-of-use
